skills: Abilities aren’t bought — they’re earned. Pull off the feat and the ability is yours forever.
Your pounce jump goes markedly higher, and you can reach perches a longer hop away.
Your zoomies charge runs much longer and recharges faster.
Finish the daily zoomies race 3 times — 0/3
Chain perch to perch along a fence line without dropping to the ground between hops.
Every cat can paddle in the shallows. Sea Legs lets you swim out into deep water — across ponds, rivers, canals and the sea.
You walk planks, ridges and washing lines quicker and steadier.
You can leap the wider gaps between the roofs.
A scent trail drifts toward the nearest collectible you have not picked up yet.
Dusk gets brighter, so you can see more.
A shimmer and a ping whenever an unfound golden mouse is close by.
Strays warm to you faster — the ♡→♥→💕 ladder climbs on fewer greets.
A held meow carries far and draws nearby strays and critters toward you.
Leave a gift at a scenic spot for ghosts and co-walkers to find.
Climb anything — trees, fences, and props that used to be scenery.
One swat topples a whole cluster — knocked props take their neighbours down with them.
Win fights to learn moves. Two can be learned early with paw points.

journal: Move slowly and stay downwind to get close.
Chase it toward a tree trunk!
Time a mid-air pounce to catch one.
Look for it near ponds and puddles.
Follow the shoreline at the seaside.
Check the sand near the tide line.
Spot it from outside its lawn — it chases cats off the grass!
Wave hello as you walk past.
Comes out after dusk — watch for the twinkle.
Nose around the crates down at the old docks.
Watch it bolt for its burrow!
Creep up softly, or it plops into the bog!

Visit the cows’ gate at the farm.

Who sleeps under the barn roof all day?
Visit the scarecrow in the wheat field.
What happens up an apple tree?
Go for a swim in the farm pond.

Hop into a seat on the big wheel at the fair.

Someone practises behind the tents at the fair.
Something bobs about in the open field at the fair.
Ride the big wheel to the very top, then jump.
Where do the pigeons go home at night?
Climb as high as a cat can go.
One roof has a warm, glowing window in it.
Someone looks at the sky from a roof.
Find a warm spot up high and sit a while.

Some birds in the square peck at crumbs.
The baker's sacks look soft and warm.
Somebody in the square plays a happy tune.

What happens if a cat paws the apple crate?
Something small squeaks behind the cheese stall.
Someone dropped a glove by the bench. Who is missing it?
The cafe tables have visitors who should not be there.
When the bicycle bell rings, how fast can you run the awnings?
A thin cat sits behind the fish stall.
